prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photo for a personal gift website. A one-year-old toddler with short fair hair makes a first unsteady independent step between two parents aged 29 and 34 seated low on the living-room floor. The dark-haired mother and clean-shaven sandy-haired father keep their hands open close by, ready to help without pulling. Show believable toddler balance, two feet and separate hands in gentle daylight, with a safe floor and no clutter. Refined warm lifestyle editorial photography with considered light and relaxed expressions. Square 1:1 gallery composition, with comfortable room around faces, hands and the complete action. Invent ordinary fictional people with distinct faces, realistic skin and believable age. Use warm paper, muted terracotta and natural surrounding colours without heavy filtering. Preserve correct anatomy, fingers, limbs and object geometry. One continuous real photograph: no fade, gradient mask, crossfade, compositing or synthetic caption band. No readable words, numbers, logos, watermarks, borders, collages or grids.

Additional anatomy and composition requirements: The toddler wears an ordinary long-sleeved cream shirt and soft muted olive trousers, with soft bare feet visible on a clean flat rug. Show one small foot flat on the floor and the other lifted slightly in a plausible first step, knees soft and body balanced. Parents sit on the floor close on either side with clearly separate open hands ready to help near the child's torso without grasping or pulling. Keep all three whole faces and important hands clearly visible and anatomically separate; no spare arms, fused fingers, impossible toddler posture or adult hands emerging from the child's body.
review: Reviewed square first-steps photo: clothed one-year-old toddler balances with one bare foot planted and the other lifted slightly. Both parents sit on the floor close by with four distinct open helping hands, without pulling the child. Faces, hands, feet and safe clear rug coherent; normal continuous photograph without gradient or caption strip.
